title: Find the value a strict majority of replicas agree on
insight: LeetCode 169 Majority Element: Boyer-Moore voting candidate plus a verification pass
prompt: The replica reconciler needs Consensus in consensus.go: given the values reported by every replica it should return the one that a strict majority agree on, per README.md. Keep the voting package name and the exported signature unchanged, stay within the standard library, and run `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` to make sure everything is clean.
